umrahPage.virtuesSubtitle: Spiritual rewards and virtues of visiting the holy lands and performing Umrah
umrahPage.introText: IPEKCI TOURISM provides comprehensive services to Muslim brothers and sisters who wish to perform the Hajj and Umrah pilgrimage, recognized as guests and servants of Allah, both domestically and internationally, assisting them with accurate information in the light of the Quran and Sunnah, free from innovations and superstitions, with experienced male and female religious officials and guides.
umrahPage.aboutUmrahDesc: Umrah is a spiritual worship performed by Muslims by visiting Mecca
umrahPage.whatIsUmrahDesc: Umrah is an important pilgrimage to Mecca that includes specific forms of worship. It can be performed at any time, but its reward increases especially during Ramadan.
umrahPage.holyPlacesDesc: The Kaaba in Mecca, the hills of Safa and Marwa, and the Prophet's Mosque in Medina are the main points of the Umrah pilgrimage.
umrahPage.bestTimesDesc: Umrah can be performed throughout the year. Ramadan is the most preferred period, especially experiencing high traffic in the last 10 days.
umrahPage.spiritualValueDesc: Umrah worship is an important act of worship that forgives sins, purifies the heart, and brings closeness to Allah.
umrahPage.medinaText1: Medina is a city with a unique spiritual atmosphere. This spiritual essence never leaves, welcoming its visitors with its sources. While breathing the peace unique to Medina, this peace continues under the strong traces of His influence, and this atmosphere and spiritual traces are passed on to future generations.
umrahPage.medinaText2: This blessed city where our Prophet Hz. Muhammad (S.A.V) lived and passed away is one of the most important centers of Islamic history. The Prophet's Mosque, Mount Uhud, and other historical sites offer visitors an unparalleled spiritual experience.
umrahPage.ourPackagesDesc: Special umrah packages prepared to suit every budget
umrahPage.transportationItem3: All transfers between Mecca and Medina
umrahPage.accommodationItem1: Comfortable hotels in Mecca and Medina
umrahPage.guidanceItem3: Visit to historical and religious sites
umrahPage.happyGuestsText: As Ipekci Tourism, we have been organizing umrah tours for 30 years, safely guiding thousands of our guests on their spiritual journeys. With our experienced staff and quality service approach, we offer you an unforgettable umrah experience.

hajjPage.subtitle: Professional and reliable service for performing the Hajj pilgrimage, one of the five pillars of Islam
hajjPage.aboutHajjDesc: Hajj is one of the most important acts of worship that Muslims must perform in Mecca at a specific time
hajjPage.whatIsHajjDesc: Hajj pilgrimage is performed every year between the 8th and 13th days of the Hijri month of Dhul-Hijjah.
hajjPage.hajjPlacesDesc: Mecca, Medina, Arafat, Muzdalifah and Mina are the sacred places where the Hajj pilgrimage is performed. Each has its own specific forms of worship.
hajjPage.hajjConditionsDesc: Being Muslim, being sane, having reached puberty, being free, and having financial and physical ability are the necessary conditions for Hajj.
hajjPage.hajjPeriodText: Between the 8th and 13th days of the Hijri month of Dhul-Hijjah
hajjPage.quotaText: Limited quota approved by the Presidency of Religious Affairs
hajjPage.earlyReservationText: We strongly recommend early reservation as quota is limited
hajjPage.requiredDocumentsText: Passport, health report, vaccination card and other official documents
hajjPage.includedDesc: Everything you need for your Hajj journey
hajjPage.transportationItem3: All land transfers with air-conditioned luxury buses
hajjPage.accommodationItem1: Comfortable hotel accommodation in Mecca and Medina
hajjPage.accommodationItem2: Tent accommodation in Mina and Arafat
hajjPage.experienceText: As Ipekci Tourism, we have been organizing hajj tours for 30 years, professionally guiding thousands of hajj candidates on this spiritual journey. With our quota approved by the Presidency of Religious Affairs and our experienced staff, we offer you the best service.

culturalPage.subtitle: Discover historical and cultural riches in the footsteps of Islamic civilization
culturalPage.intro1: As Ipekci Tourism, we invite you to a journey that goes deep into history. From Istanbul's unique historical and cultural treasures to Antakya's ancient civilizations, from Bursa's magnificent legacies to Lebanon's thousands-of-years-old mountains, you will experience unforgettable moments across a wide geography.
culturalPage.intro2: Following the traces of Islamic civilization, we will discover historical buildings, museums, mosques and cultural riches together. Each of our tours is carefully planned to offer you an unforgettable experience with our expert guides, accommodation in 5-star hotels and our highest level of service approach.
culturalPage.comfortableTransportDesc: Safe and comfortable travel with Turkish Airlines
culturalPage.expertGuidesDesc: Our Turkish-speaking guides experienced in history and culture
culturalPage.fiveStarHotelsDesc: Luxury accommodation and top-level service quality
culturalPage.uniqueMapText: We make a difference in cultural tours on our country's unique map! To know our culture from A to Z, including religions, languages, tastes, history, nature, sea, plains, valleys - in short, traveling through different cities of Anatolia, enjoying the unlimited Mediterranean, Aegean coasts, pleasant moments in the magnificent nature of its shores become unforgettable with İPEKCİ TOURISM...
culturalPage.natureToursText: In the untouched unique beauty of green in the Black Sea, in the peaceful environment of the Islands in Istanbul, on the unique map of Bursa Yedigöller and in all corners of Anatolia that has hosted thousands of years and dozens of civilizations, live the moments you will remember with pleasant, nice memories with İPEKCİ TOURISM Nature Tours...
culturalPage.everyCornerText: In every region of Turkey, away from the stress caused by life, in thermal facilities with high standards that are comfortable and well-equipped, a healing holiday intertwined with nature awaits you with İPEKCİ TOURISM...

aboutPage.storyText1: Ipekci Tourism was established in 2009 to provide services in the field of Umrah and Hajj organizations. From day one, our mission has been to provide our guests with a safe, comfortable and spiritually peaceful travel experience.
